summary: Gulf_Union declared itself open to joining any other empire or meganation, offering its leader as the point of contact.

evidence.key_text: We are also open to joining any other empires/meganations. Just dm me or msg me in game [Hoffywin9999] to talk about that.

analyst_notes: Recorded separately from the departure because it is an actionable diplomatic opening rather than a loss to the Ostafrikan meganation: a nation with a named, reachable decision-maker is advertising that it will accept a new patron. Note the contact name is given in-game, so it can be resolved against the EarthMC API to identify the account and its town.
why_it_matters: A free agent nation actively seeking a patron. This is the one item in the batch that a ministry can act on directly.
